chapter: Haiti, Artie Shaw and Los Angeles work
title: Budd Johnson in Chicago
summary: He met Johnson in Chicago in the early thirties and heard him in after-hours spots, ranking him with Lester Young and Ben Webster.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: Yeah, but this is -- this was New York. And speaking of going back to New York, returning, I always see musicians who I've worked with and I have beautiful memories working with. I saw Bud Johnson, who I've known for years and years. I met Bud in Chicago, oh, in the early thirties, actually. Bud was a very important person, musically. He was actually considered along with Lester Young and Ben Webster as one of the giants, even then.
Did you work with him in Chicago (inaudible)?
I worked with Bud in Chicago, and went to hear him wherever he played. When I wasn't working I admired him so I would go to hear him play, the after hours spots, clubs. And --
